name: 01-boot-transient-53c21b4
description: Cold-start AE transient: total_gain reads a wild 15000-20000 for the first moments after boot (AE not converged), in a bright room persisted as day. The pre-fix machine committed straight to night off that single transient because the first-ever switch bypassed the dwell. The boot settle (floor + AE-stability extension) must eat the transient: no switch to night, at most the one genuine day confirmation.
